Agent Name: FinancialData_Expert
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to address the core constraint of the task: obtaining data "without adjusting for stock split." Google Finance's standard "Historical Data" download feature automatically adjusts prices for splits and dividends. By immediately assuming the standard download would suffice and failing to implement a method to retrieve unadjusted data (or to download the split-adjusted data and manually reverse the adjustments), the agent set the entire workflow on a flawed premise. This fundamental misunderstanding of the data source's behavior led to the subsequent failure to find the correct historical price point, as the unadjusted price of Apple stock has never exceeded $50 (it was around $10-$15 in the 90s and adjusted upwards via splits). The error occurred at the very first step of planning/execution because the agent did not verify the data characteristics before proceeding.
